_doc: Render massing for Hoog Mosscher (stately home on a moated island, Hoog Mosscher 83; OSM way 868297311, historic=castle), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1756857 rendered as a flat 17.4 m white block that read as an apartment building. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (vertex mean), u along 'axis_deg' -135.9 (u south-west, v south-east). DHMV II: main block u -8.8..6.4, v -18.7..-4.4 with a hipped roof (eaves ~10 m, top ~14 m), a corner turret near u -5.5, v -4.5 to ~18 m, a lower middle section to ~12 m and a north wing ~9 m. Look (Google satellite and Street View from Hoog Mosscher, look-up only): red brick with white window frames, dark slate roofs with dormers, among tall trees inside the moat.
